{{Quote|I tell you now, Garnet. You bad smuggler. Verr bad. Make Mogroch angry.|The Muur to Roark Garnet|<ref name="RPG" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''Muur''' was employed by a being called [[Mogroch]]. The [[Muur]] threatened [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] when the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] failed to pay 10,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] he owed to Mogroch.<ref name="RPG" />
